items.reason: It asserts the same null-config NPE in getLoginPredicate. Listing additional affected operations does not change the claimed cause.

It claims organization enable/disable leaves cached login membership stale without filtering effective isEnabled. This differs from missing organization-aware wrappers (#03) and missing invalidation on linking/unlinking (#04).
It identifies the same shared realm/mode cache entry accumulating organization-specific searches. Memory churn and broad invalidation are additional consequences of the same cache-key design.
